title: Huoxiang Zhengqi Oral Liquid Attenuates LPS-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Modulating Short-Chain Fatty Acid Levels and TLR4/NF-kappaB p65 Pathway.
authors: Tang, Ruying; Zhang, Jianjun; Zhang, Rui; Li, Xinyu; Lv, Ruilin; Nan, Haipeng; Liu, Jinlian; Zhao, Zhongpeng; He, Wei; Wang, Linyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药藿香正气口服液通过SCFAs和TLR4/NF-κB通路减轻LPS诱导的急性肺损伤，核心为炎症信号通路与药理机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Huoxiang Zhengqi Oral Liquid (HZOL) is a classic Chinese patent medicine used in China for more than 1,000 years in treating gastrointestinal and respiratory diseases. Clinically applied HZOL in early respiratory disease stages can reduce the proportion of lung infection patients that progress to severe acute lung injury (ALI). However, few pharmacological studies evaluated its level of protection against ALI. We explored mechanisms of HZOL against ALI by employing network pharmacology, molecular docking, and rat experiments. Firstly, network pharmacology prediction and published biological evaluation of active ingredients of HZOL suggested that HZOL exerted the protective effect in treating ALI mainly in the areas of regulation of cell adhesion, immune response, and inflammatory response and closely related to the NF-kappaB pathway. Secondly, molecular docking results demonstrated that imperatorin and isoimperatorin combined well with targets in the NF-kappaB pathway. Finally, ALI rats induced by lipopolysaccharides (LPS) were used to validate prediction after pretreatment with HZOL for 2 weeks. Results confirmed that lung and colon injury occurred in ALI rats. Furthermore, HZOL exerts anti-inflammatory effects on LPS-induced ALI and gut injury by repairing lung and colon pathology, reducing and alleviating pulmonary edema, inhibiting abnormal enhancement of thymus and spleen index, modulating hematologic indices, and increasing levels of total short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in the cecum. Additionally, abnormal accumulation of inflammatory cytokines IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma in serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid was significantly reduced after pretreating with HZOL. Furthermore, HZOL downregulated the expression of TLR4, CD14, and MyD88 and phosphorylation of NF-kappaB p65 in lung tissue. Altogether, HZOL was found to exert an anti-inflammatory effect regulation by increasing levels of SCFAs, inhibiting the accumulation of inflammatory cytokines, and attenuating the activation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB p65 pathway. Our study provided experimental evidences for the application of HZOL in preventing and treating ALI.
abstract_zh: 藿香正气口服液（HZOL）是一种经典的中成药，在中国已使用超过1000年，用于治疗胃肠和呼吸系统疾病。在呼吸系统疾病早期临床应用中，HZOL可降低肺感染患者进展为严重急性肺损伤（ALI）的比例。然而，关于其对ALI保护作用的药理学研究较少。我们通过网络药理学、分子对接和大鼠实验探讨了HZOL对抗ALI的机制。首先，网络药理学预测及已发表的HZOL活性成分生物学评价表明，HZOL在治疗ALI中发挥保护作用主要涉及细胞黏附、免疫应答和炎症反应的调节，并与NF-kappaB通路密切相关。其次，分子对接结果显示，欧前胡素（imperatorin）和异欧前胡素（isoimperatorin）与NF-kappaB通路中的靶点结合良好。最后，使用脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI大鼠在HZOL预处理2周后进行验证。结果证实，ALI大鼠出现肺和结肠损伤。此外，HZOL通过修复肺和结肠病理、减轻和缓解肺水肿、抑制胸腺和脾脏指数异常升高、调节血液学指标以及增加盲肠中总短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）水平，对LPS诱导的ALI和肠道损伤发挥抗炎作用。另外，HZOL预处理后，血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液中炎症细胞因子IL-6、IL-1beta、TNF-alpha和IFN-gamma的异常积累显著减少。进一步地，HZOL下调了肺组织中TLR4、CD14和MyD88的表达以及NF-kappaB p65的磷酸化。总之，HZOL被发现通过增加SCFAs水平、抑制炎症细胞因子积累和减弱TLR4/NF-kappaB p65通路激活来发挥抗炎调节作用。我们的研究为HZOL在预防和治疗ALI中的应用提供了实验证据。
